name: neo
description: Multi-agent semantic reasoning system with persistent memory for code suggestions, architectural guidance, and optimization recommendations

interface.longDescription: Neo is a mode-explicit reasoning helper. Codex advise skills send only explicitly curated task context: implicit directory and project-instruction discovery plus persistent fact retrieval are disabled by default. External-provider calls use Codex approval with provider and data scope disclosed. Shared memory is opt-in for advise and used by deliberate `learn` workflows with its provider and persistence effects disclosed. `agent` requires explicit workspace authority plus a host executor; Neo never executes generated shell commands. Requires the neo CLI installed locally (`pip install neo-reasoner[openai]`).
defaultPrompt: Ask Neo to reason over a small, explicitly approved code context
Have Neo review selected code without scanning the rest of the workspace
